purpose: Fixed reference-recipe XGBoost comparison; no liquid retuning
features: Same 17 causal sensor, delta, history and clock features; no room identity
split: Existing dataset.pt: first 12 selected days fit, next 2 validation, remaining future

variants.all-prefix: One pooled model, every unique fit row from H1-H6
variants.block-matched: One pooled model, exactly the full contiguous 36-row blocks used by offline liquid gradient fitting

weights: Pooled fitting class count mean divided by each label's count, as in verified-liquid-board.tree_fit
selection: No hyperparameter, round or threshold selection; validation reported only
limitations: Single seed and one fixed reference recipe, not an optimized XGBoost ceiling
Liquid future results already known before this baseline was specified
Six streams per room are replicas, not additional training evidence
Live liquid learns chronologically from fit plus validation prefixes; offline liquid uses validation for selection and calibration; XGBoost fits only the fit prefix
